info.name: AirAPI - Technical-stop elapsedTime (live response shape)
info.description: Ticket-scoped black-box regression for the observed AirAPI Search response. Credentials are environment variables. Original integration identity is read from keys.original_info.gds.

exec: const atPath = function (root, path) { return path.split('.').reduce(function (value, part) { return value == null ? undefined : value[part]; }, root); };
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { pm.test('Search response is JSON', function () { throw error; }); return; }
pm.test('Search has a results array', function () { pm.expect(body.results).to.be.an('array'); });

body.results.forEach(function (option, optionIndex) { const originalGds = atPath(option, 'keys.original_info.gds'); if (filter && originalGds !== filter) return; (option.trips || []).forEach(function (trip, tripIndex) { (trip.segments || []).forEach(function (segment, segmentIndex) { if (Number(segment.stop) > 0) candidates.push({ optionIndex: optionIndex, tripIndex: tripIndex, segmentIndex: segmentIndex, segment: segment }); }); }); });
if (cfg('expected_result') === 'valid') pm.test('A matching positive-stop segment is returned', function () { pm.expect(candidates.length).to.be.above(0); });
if (cfg('expected_result') === 'no_match_allowed' && candidates.length === 0) pm.test('No matching sandbox inventory is allowed', function () { pm.expect(candidates.length).to.equal(0); });

candidates.forEach(function (candidate) { const segment = candidate.segment; const stops = segment.stops || []; stops.forEach(function (stop, stopIndex) { const departure = stopIndex === 0 ? segment.departureTime : stops[stopIndex - 1].departureDateTime; const expectedMinutes = (Date.parse(stop.arrivalDateTime) - Date.parse(departure)) / 60000; const actual = atPath(stop, cfg('elapsed_time_path')); const label = 'option ' + candidate.optionIndex + ', trip ' + candidate.tripIndex + ', segment ' + candidate.segmentIndex + ', stop ' + stopIndex; pm.test(label + ' has parseable boundary timestamps', function () { pm.expect(Date.parse(departure)).to.not.be.NaN; pm.expect(Date.parse(stop.arrivalDateTime)).to.not.be.NaN; }); if (!Number.isFinite(expectedMinutes)) return; pm.test(label + ' has elapsedTime', function () { pm.expect(actual).to.not.be.oneOf([undefined, null, '']); }); pm.test(label + ' differs from local-time calculation only by whole timezone hours', function () { pm.expect(Math.abs(expectedMinutes - Number(actual)) % 60).to.equal(0); }); }); });
